description: Xiaohongshu x-s test vectors, generated by running the ORIGINAL extracted signer payload in Node under the logging harness on fixed inputs (make xhs).
why: The signer entry glb['_AUuXfEG27Xa3x'](url, body, ctx) aborts with an environment-integrity error (err:d93135) when run headless in Node, before emitting x-s/x-t. This is an anti-tamper check (it reads document.documentElement.getAttribute just before aborting). We do not defeat it: doing so approaches building a working signer, which this project keeps out of the public repo by design. Therefore no validated x-s vectors exist to publish, and the understanding-level results are in analysis/xhs/.

reachable_partial_output.note: This is the deterministic output of a REACHABLE internal helper, NOT a valid x-s. It shows the to-be-signed string construction (URL + LCG constant 1013904243). Published only as reproducible evidence of the pipeline shape; it does not sign any request.

pass_rate: N/A (no validated vectors; headless signing blocked by env-integrity check)
